entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. This VeloBand sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you provide the order number? And just to be clear, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
The order is 774-B2. And I guess it's a preference. It's just very... confusing.
I understand. I'm pulling up your order now. Can you tell me a bit more about what you're finding confusing? Sometimes there's a feature we can walk you through.
Look, I read the user manual. It's just hard to use. The whole interface is a mess and I honestly expected more for the price.
I'm very sorry to hear that it's not meeting your expectations. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I see here that the VeloBand was delivered 34 days ago. Let's see... our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. So, you're well within that timeframe.
Oh. Fine. So you'll take it back then?

Yes, absolutely. I can initiate the return for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.

Of course. I've just sent that email with the label and instructions. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Once we receive the item, you can expect a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I do apologize again that the product wasn't the right fit for you. Have a good day.
